description:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally apply for planning permission for a footway crossing (dropped kerb) at my residence address - 273 Martin Way, London Sw209BU. I wish to create a vehicular access point across the footway to enable off-street parking on my private hardstanding.

I am pleased to confirm that a Technical Support Officer from Sustainable Transport, Highways and Climate has already conducted a site assessment at the above address. Following this assessment, the application has been approved in principle based on the Highway's current policy in terms of sightlines, depth, and width requirements.

In support of this application, I enclose the following documents as provided by the Council:
- A sketch drawing of the proposed footway crossing as prepared by the Highways team

I kindly request that this application be processed and progressed to the next stage at your earliest convenience. I am happy to provide any further information or supporting documents required.

Yours faithfully,
Sumit bhardwaj
